transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... well, I guess I'm here because... I've been having some trouble lately. It's just, after a long day on the site, or if I have a late neighborhood meeting, I'll get home and... I just end up eating way more than I meant to. Just whatever is around, really. Leftover takeout, cereal, chips... I just kind of keep going until I'm uncomfortably full. So... yeah. That's mainly it.
During these times when you eat more than you meant to, do you feel like you're not in control of how much you're eating, or like you can't stop once you start?

Yeah... I guess so. It's just... once I start on those evenings, it kind of feels like I'm on autopilot. I'll be telling myself to stop, you know, because I have an early start with the crew the next morning... but I just keep going back to the kitchen for more anyway. So, yeah.
After these episodes of eating more than you intended, do you ever try to compensate by doing something like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?

Um... well, not all of that. But... yeah, sometimes. Maybe a few times a month. 

I just... I get panicked, I guess. About undoing all the work I put into looking put-together. So, um... I have gone into the bathroom and... made myself throw up. But it's not every time. Just... sometimes.
Can you tell me more about those times you made yourself throw up—what usually leads up to that, and how often does it happen?

Um... I don't know, it's just... like I said, I just feel too full and get panicked. That's really all that leads up to it. 

As for how often... if I look back over the last few months, I guess it averages out to about once a week. Um... some weeks it might happen twice, and then other weeks not at all. It just... varies, I guess.
Do these episodes of eating more than you intend usually happen when you're feeling stressed, upset, or dealing with a bad mood?

Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't noticed a pattern like that. It's not really about being upset or... in a bad mood, I don't think. I just... I haven't really paid attention to my mood when it happens.
Can you tell me more about what it feels like when you're eating during these episodes—do you feel like you can't control yourself or that you can't stop eating, even if you wanted to?

Um... yeah, I guess so. It's... hard to explain. 

Once I start eating on those evenings, it's just... it feels a bit like I'm on autopilot. Like, in my head, I'm telling myself to stop. I know I have an early start with the crew the next morning, and I need to get some sleep, but... I just keep going back to the kitchen for more anyway. It's... yeah, it feels hard to stop once it starts.
How often would you say you use compensatory behaviors, like making yourself vomit, after these eating episodes?

Um... I think I mentioned it earlier. Looking back over the last few months... it averages out to about once a week. Like I said, some weeks it might be twice, other weeks not at all. But... yeah, about weekly.
Do these episodes of eating more than you intend cause you a lot of distress, or interfere with things like work, relationships, or daily activities?

Um... I don't know if I'd say a lot of distress, really. I mean... I'm still showing up. I'm doing my job, and... getting things done. 

It's just... I guess I've started turning down some things. Like, if the crew wants to grab food after a meeting, I might just... say no. Or I'll kind of rush home, because... I don't know, I just worry the evening will get away from me. But I'm still working fine.
Do you usually feel down, anxious, or especially stressed before or during these episodes of overeating?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't really paid attention to that. I just... I get home and it happens. I'm not sure I feel any particular way beforehand.
Can you tell me if you feel like you can’t control yourself or stop eating during these episodes, even if you want to?

Um... I guess so. Once I start on those evenings... it's kind of like I'm on autopilot. I... I know I have an early crew start the next day, and I tell myself to stop. But... I just end up going back to the kitchen for more anyway.
Do you feel unhappy with your body shape or weight, especially after these episodes of eating more than you meant to?

Um... I guess you could say that. It's just... lately I've been wearing more fitted clothes at work, since I'm up front at meetings more often now. And... I don't know. I just catch myself judging the whole day by whether my pants feel tight, or... if I think people can see my stomach. So... yeah.
Would you say that your feelings about your body shape or weight have a strong impact on how you see yourself overall?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Like I was just saying... I basically judge my whole day on it now. If my work clothes feel tight, or... if I'm worrying about my stomach while I'm up front... it just makes me feel bad about myself in general. So... yes.
Would you say that your self-worth is largely determined by how you feel about your body shape or weight?

Um... I feel like I kind of just answered that. But... yeah. Like I said, since I started wearing more fitted clothes for those meetings... I just catch myself judging my entire day by whether my pants feel tight, or... if I think people can see my stomach. So... yes.
